app.title: OpenDevTrack
projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Name
projects.key_help: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter: it prefixes the issues (ODT-42)
projects.key_invalid: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter
projects.key_taken: A project with this key already exists
projects.lead_not_member: Check the fields: the lead must be a member of the project
projects.member_failed: The member could not be added
projects.last_admin: A project keeps at least one admin
common.changed_meanwhile: Someone else changed it in the meantime: reload and try again
issues.title: Issues
issues.cannot_create: Only a developer or an admin of the project creates issues
issues.reviewer_help: A member of the project other than the assignee
issues.due_on_help: The day it should be done; past it, and not done, the issue is overdue
issues.author: Author
issues.conditions_not_met: The conditions of this step are not met
issues.linked_issue_help: Its key or words of its summary
issues.already_linked: The issues are already linked this way
issues.not_watching: You are no longer watching this issue
projects.field_key_help: Lower-case letters, digits and _, from a letter; it does not change
projects.field_options_help: For select and multiselect: one per line, value or value: Label
projects.field_required_if_help: A CEL expression on issue and user, for example issue.type == "bug"; true for always, empty for never
projects.field_archived_help: Out of the forms; the values stay in the issues
projects.field_invalid: Check the key, the options and the rule
projects.field_exists: The project already has a field with this key
validation.customFieldInvalid: Not a valid value for this field
validation.customFieldUnknown: The project has no such field
projects.condition_help: A CEL expression on issue and user, for example issue.assignee != null; empty for none
projects.code_help: Lower-case letters, digits and _, from a letter; it does not change
projects.category_help: Groups the status on boards and reports
projects.position_help: From 1: the first status is the one of new issues, in the category To do
projects.move_to_help: The issues of the removed status go there; the transitions from or to it are removed too
projects.status_invalid: Check the code, the category and the position: the first status is To do, each category keeps a status, a code has the same category in every workflow
projects.status_exists: The workflow already has a status with this code
projects.transition_invalid: Check from, to and the condition: two different statuses, the condition in CEL
projects.transition_exists: The workflow already has a transition with this code
projects.remove_transition_confirm: Remove the transition {code}? The issues stay where they are.
projects.workflow_name_help: A copy of the default workflow, with this name
projects.workflow_exists: The project already has a workflow with this name
projects.workflow_default_help: It serves the issue types that no other workflow maps
projects.workflow_types_help: The issues of these types follow this workflow; a type taken from another workflow keeps its status, or moves to the first one of the same category
projects.workflow_saved: Saved: the issues of the types it took or gave back follow their new workflow
projects.remove_workflow_confirm: Remove the workflow {name}? It serves no issue type.
projects.workflow_in_use: Only a workflow that serves no issue type is removed
issues.labels_help: Lower case letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; Enter or a comma adds one
agile.kind_help: Scrum: the issues of the active sprint; kanban: every issue
agile.columns_help: One per line, Name: status, status | limit, for example Doing: in_progress | 3; empty for one column per status
agile.board_invalid: Check the columns: each holds statuses of the workflow, each status in one column
agile.remove_board_confirm: Remove the board {name}? The issues stay.
agile.last_board: A project keeps at least one board
agile.active_sprint_help: A scrum board shows the issues of the active sprint
agile.no_active_sprint: No sprint is active: start one from the backlog
agile.no_transition: No step of the workflow leads there now: check its conditions
agile.move_failed: The card could not be moved
agile.backlog_help: Drag an issue onto a sprint to plan it, or up and down to change its place in the order of the project.
agile.sprint_help: Planned from the backlog of the project; empty for the backlog
agile.sprint_name_help: Empty for the next number: ODT Sprint 3
agile.ends_on_help: Empty for two weeks after the start
agile.already_active: Another sprint is active: complete it first
agile.sprint_invalid: Check the name and the dates: a sprint ends on or after the day it starts
agile.too_many_sprints: A project has at most 9 sprints not completed
agile.remove_sprint_confirm: Remove {name}? Its issues go back to the backlog.
agile.points_help: From 0 to 999; empty when not estimated
agile.points_invalid: The story points are from 0 to 999
search.title: Search
search.help: Write a query and press Enter. For example: `type = bug AND assignee = currentUser()`, `status IN (todo, in_progress) ORDER BY priority DESC`, `text ~ "coupon" AND created >= -14d`. The field suggests fields, operators and values as you type.
search.shared_help: Everyone in the organisation sees the filter; each one finds only the issues they may see
search.wrong_query: The query is not right: check it in the field above
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.overdue_help: Your open issues past their due date
dashboard.reviewing_help: Issues in progress you are the reviewer of
dashboard.critical_help: Open bugs with the highest priority in your projects
dashboard.resolved_help: Issues of your projects resolved since Monday
dashboard.my_filters_help: Your saved filters marked «On my dashboard» in Search, with the issues each one finds now.
reports.title: Project dashboard
reports.cycle_time_caption: median days from start to done
reports.cycle_time_help: Of the issues resolved in the last 30 days that went through a status in progress
reports.burndown_caption: Story points left in the chosen sprint, else in the active or the last one, day by day
reports.burndown_sprint_help: Empty: the active sprint, or the last one
reports.velocity_caption: Story points of the last six completed sprints
reports.flow_caption: Issues per status category, last 30 days
reports.created_resolved_caption: Issues created and resolved per day, last 30 days
notification_settings.description: How OpenDevTrack tells you about your work: in the application, by email at once, or in a daily summary.
notification_settings.mail_off: This installation sends no email: only the choices in the application apply.
agile.board_filter_help: An ODQL query, for example labels = payments or assignee = currentUser(): only the issues it finds are cards; empty for every issue
agile.board_filter_shown: Only the issues this ODQL query finds are on the board
webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.help: Each webhook receives the events of the project it wants, posted as JSON and signed with its secret (Standard Webhooks).
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.url_help: An https address on the internet, for example https://chat.example.org/hooks/123
webhooks.events_help: What it is told about; * for every event, those of tomorrow too
webhooks.active_help: Off: nothing is queued or posted. Turned off by itself after three days of failures
webhooks.exists: The project already has a webhook with this name, or ten webhooks
webhooks.invalid: Check the name, the address (https, on the internet) and the events
webhooks.secret_help: Copy it now into the receiver, which checks the signature with it: it is not shown again
webhooks.secret_kept: Keep the secret safe: it is not shown again
webhooks.ping_sent: A test event is on its way
webhooks.rotate_confirm: Make a new signing secret? For a day the old one signs too, so that the receiver can change it.
webhooks.remove_confirm: Remove the webhook {name}? Its deliveries go with it.
webhooks.deliveries_help: The last 50, kept for 30 days. A failed one is tried again after 1, 5 and 30 minutes, then 2, 6 and 12 hours: seven attempts in about a day. A webhook that has failed for three days is turned off.
webhooks.again_queued: Queued again: it is posted within a minute
admin.users_help: The users of this tenant and their roles. Passwords and sign-in are managed in the identity provider (Keycloak): a user is added there first, then here.
admin.roles_help: The roles in this tenant. Project roles are given in each project.
admin.user_invalid: Check the user name and the email
admin.sign_out_confirm: End every session of {name} in this tenant? They sign in again.
admin.turn_off_confirm: Turn off {name}? They can no longer sign in to any tenant.
admin.global_roles_help: What each role gives in a tenant. The roles of the system cannot change; the others are changed by the global admin.
admin.tenant_code_help: Letters, digits, - and _; it cannot change
admin.tenant_exists: A tenant with this code exists
admin.tenant_invalid: Check the code: letters, digits, - and _
admin.access_log_help: The last 200 changes to users, roles and tenants, the most recent first.
admin.schemes_help: What each project role gives. A project uses the default scheme until its admin picks another one in the project. Every role sees the issues; the admin always edits the project and manages its members.
admin.add_scheme_help: It starts as a copy of the default scheme
admin.scheme_exists: A scheme with this name exists
admin.scheme_rules: Every role sees the issues, and the admin always edits the project and manages its members
admin.name: Name
projects.scheme_help: What each project role gives here; the admin of the workspace defines the schemes
projects.scheme_pick_help: The schemes of the workspace, in Administration
admin.role_refused: Not allowed: nobody changes their own roles, and only the global admin gives the role of global admin
admin.groups_help: A group gives its members a role in the projects it is added to; the highest role of each user counts. Mentions and assignments stay per user.
admin.group_exists: A group with this name exists
admin.remove_group: Remove the group {name}? Its projects lose it too.
admin.last_admin: A project would be left without an admin: give it another one first
projects.group_help: The groups of the workspace, in Administration
projects.remove_group: Remove the group {name} from the project?
